sourceSignal: ENSIP-26 agent text records create a natural metadata surface for agent identity and discoverability.

idea.title: ENS Agent Text Record Verifier
idea.summary: Add a verifier that reads agent ENS text records and compiles a portable identity receipt for DreamNet steward agents.
idea.whyNew: Most ENS demos stop at resolving names. This treats ENS records as machine-readable agent identity and discovery metadata.

findings: No wallet signing required for the first prototype.
Do not publish attestations until real records are verified.

steps: Read ENS name from operator input.
Resolve text records using a read-only provider.
Normalize records into a DreamNet identity receipt.
Display unresolved/missing records as warnings, not failures.
tests: Run schema validation against the sample receipt.
Run read-only resolver smoke with known public ENS names.
